================================================================================
Oracle units: a package spec with two headers
================================================================================

CREATE OR REPLACE PACKAGE pk AUTHID DEFINER AS
  c CONSTANT NUMBER := 1;
  FUNCTION one RETURN NUMBER;
  PROCEDURE p (a IN NUMBER, b OUT VARCHAR2);
END pk;
SELECT 1 FROM dual;

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(source_file
  (statement)
  (statement))

================================================================================
Oracle units: a package body with two functions and a part that runs at load
================================================================================

CREATE OR REPLACE EDITIONABLE PACKAGE BODY hr.pk AS
  g NUMBER := 0;
  FUNCTION one RETURN NUMBER IS
    v NUMBER := 0;
  BEGIN
    FOR i IN 1 .. 3 LOOP
      IF i > 1 THEN
        v := v + i;
      END IF;
    END LOOP;
    RETURN v;
  END one;
  PROCEDURE p (a IN NUMBER, b OUT VARCHAR2) IS
  BEGIN
    b := CASE WHEN a > 0 THEN 'pos' ELSE 'neg' END;
  END;
BEGIN
  g := one;
END pk;
SELECT 1 FROM dual;

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(source_file
  (statement
    (string)
    (string))
  (statement))

================================================================================
Oracle units: a package body with no part that runs at load and END;
================================================================================

create package body pk is
  procedure p is
  begin
    null;
  end p;
end;
select 1 from dual;

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(source_file
  (statement)
  (statement))

================================================================================
Oracle units: a nested procedure and a call specification in a package body
================================================================================

create package body pk as
  procedure outer_p is
    procedure inner_p is
    begin
      null;
    end;
  begin
    inner_p;
  end;
  function ext return number as language c name "ext" library l;
end pk;
select 1 from dual;

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(source_file
  (statement
    (quoted_identifier))
  (statement))

================================================================================
Oracle units: quoted names and a CASE in a declaration
================================================================================

create package body "PK" as
  c number := case when 1 = 1 then 1 else 0 end;
  procedure p is begin null; end;
end "PK";
select 1 from dual;

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  (statement
    (quoted_identifier)
    (quoted_identifier))
  (statement))

================================================================================
Oracle units: a type body with two members
================================================================================

CREATE OR REPLACE TYPE BODY t AS
  MEMBER FUNCTION area RETURN NUMBER IS
  BEGIN
    RETURN a * a;
  END;
  CONSTRUCTOR FUNCTION t (x NUMBER) RETURN SELF AS RESULT IS
  BEGIN
    a := x;
    RETURN;
  END;
END;
SELECT 1 FROM dual;

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(source_file
  (statement)
  (statement))

================================================================================
Oracle units: a type that is not a type body
================================================================================

CREATE TYPE t AS OBJECT (a NUMBER);
CREATE TYPE body AS OBJECT (a NUMBER);
CREATE TYPE "body" AS OBJECT (a NUMBER);
SELECT 1 FROM dual;

  (statement))

================================================================================
Oracle units: a package spec, its body and a select
================================================================================

create or replace package usql_pk as function one return number; end usql_pk;
create or replace package body usql_pk as function one return number as begin return 1; end; end usql_pk;
select usql_pk.one as one from dual;

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  (statement)
  (statement)
  (statement))
